about: Tyler Injury Law is a personal injury firm with a single office in Tempe.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; it will visit clients in hospital or at home. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

json_ld_descriptions: Tyler Injury Law offers aggressive representation focused on delivering the best possible outcome on every case. We are a full service personal injury firm. Not only will we manage your claim through the pre-litigation process, we also litigate when the insurance companies act unreasonably. We treat your claim as if it is our own. Our methods and strategies are tested and proven. Whether it is a simple fender-bender or a catastrophic accident, we offer the same attention, service, and aid to each client.
